thread:
alex: Quick update from the microbatch sizing experiment. Rolled out the kernel-chooser + adaptive microbatching patch to canary. Immediately saw p95 improve but p99 jumped ~2.2x on a small fraction of requests.

maria: Can you paste the profiler top traces for the p99 samples?

alex: Pasted a short stack dump below and a sample log. Looks like sequences >1200 trigger a different kernel path and we get a KV cache miss + tool-call loop in a couple cases.

jin: profiler snippet (p99 sample):
```
sampler: 50ms
serve_inference -> select_kernel(decision: sequence_len=1456)
  -> attention_kernel_opt (fallback to matmul_unfused)
  -> KVCache::load_miss -> fetch_remote_kv
  -> tool_call_handler -> loop:CALL_TOOL x 3
  -> post_process
```

kelly: Interesting — kernel-chooser picks attention_kernel_opt for long contexts but it has a slow path if seq_len > 1024 and quantized layout mismatch. fallback to matmul_unfused loses CUDA graph reuse. That plus remote KV fetch explains the extra 500-800ms.

sanjay: I examined the raw app logs for that request (id=f2c9). Tool loop looks like: `CALL_TOOL(lookup)` then model emits a followup prompt that triggers another `CALL_TOOL`. It's an outlier generation pattern (tool chain recursion) not seen in normal prompts.

alex: So root causes: (1) long prompt pushes kernel choice to slower path, (2) KV cache cold miss causing remote fetch, (3) outlier generation with repeated tool calls extending compute. All three combine multiplicatively for p99.

tim: For mitigation options: short term we can tighten kernel-chooser thresholds to prefer stable kernel for seq in [1024,1600] when remote_kv_flag==true; also cap microbatch size to 1 for seq>1024 to avoid batching-induced stalls. Medium-term: fix quantized layout mismatch and add local prefetch for hot KV prefixes.

maria: Do we have numbers on impact of capping microbatch to 1? Perf-bot, can you show a quick comparison from the canary window?

perf-bot: Canary metrics (last 30m):
- baseline (adaptive microbatch default): p95=120ms, p99=820ms, error_rate=0.3%
- with kernel-threshold tweak + microbatch cap for seq>1024: p95=130ms, p99=360ms, error_rate=0.28%
- cost delta: +4% tokens/sec for the canary due to smaller batches

jin: The profiler also shows that when the kernel fallback occurs we lose all kernel-level caching of tactic selection (kernel heuristics table misses). Need to persist tactic selection for common seq ranges and model variants.

kelly: Proposed action items:
- short-term (today): deploy kernel-threshold tweak in canary and enforce microbatch=1 for seq>1024 for hosted tier.
- infra (48h): add a KV prefetch for recent prefixes + increase local KV cache size by 2x on the serving nodes.
- medium (2w): fix quantization layout mismatch so attention_kernel_opt stays fast for larger seq lengths.
- product: add a guardrail to discourage tool loops in user prompts (rate-limit CALL_TOOL in a single generation session).

sanjay: I'll dig into the specific outlier request corpus and redact any user data, then add it to our regression probe set. Found 7 similar tool-loop patterns in the last week.

alex: Thanks. I'll cut the canary patch now (rolling to 5% until we confirm stability). If p99 falls and no new regressions, we'll promote.

maria: Please also add unit test for kernel-chooser with synthetic long-context sequences and a KV-miss simulation.

tim: For longer-term SLO vs throughput tradeoffs, we should run a guided sweep: vary microbatch cap {1,2,4} for seq bins and log p50/p95/p99 + tokens/sec. We can plot pareto frontier and pick default.

kelly: Agreed. I'll create the sweep matrix and schedule a run on a spare pool tomorrow.

alex: Cool — action owners: alex deploy canary, kelly run sweep, sanjay build regression probe, jin work on tactic persistence, tim draft SLO docs.

perf-bot: Noted. Will post updated charts in #eng-runtime once sweep completes. :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

maria: Nice triage, team. Small follow-up: add a short note to the release notes about the microbatch change so support can field user questions.

alex: Will do.

kelly: Quick config snippet for the kernel-chooser tweak: 
```
kernel_chooser:
  seq_threshold: 1024
  prefer_stable_kernel_if_kv_miss: true
  batch_size_limit_by_seq:
    - max_seq: 1024
      max_microbatch: 16
    - max_seq: 1600
      max_microbatch: 1
```

alex: Thanks — closing the thread after canary complete.
